text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek and I are returning from a shopping trip.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Wow, we must have lost track of time buying all these things. It's so late!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …What's that?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck at our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a coupon for a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You two over there! Care to try your luck?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We've already got a raffle ticket, so why don't we give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All right! Give it all you've got! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's fun just just to watch, so go for it! Woo, woo! You can do it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Super Creek's passionate support, I give the raffle drum a turn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Goodness gracious! The grand-prize?! That's incredible!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: This must be your reward for always being such a good trainer! ♪
choice_data_list: It was your raffle ticket, so this belongs to you.
It was your raffle ticket, so this belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, it's yours because you're the one who drew it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Take a relaxing dip in the hot springs and wash all of your exhaustion away! ♪
choice_data_list: But I want you to rest too, Creek.
But I want you to rest too, Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …You're always so kind.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How about we go together then?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Of course. The trip would be more fun that way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But now's probably not the best time…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And it's a particularly important period for you, so…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Why don't we go after we've fulfilled our Twinkle Series wish?
choice_data_list: I like the sound of that. A trip to celebrate a job well done.
I like the sound of that. A trip to celebrate a job well done.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm looking forward to it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I make a promise with Super Creek and hold on to the coupon for the hot spring trip.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness! ♪ Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It says, "The top-quality meat and carrots make for a mouthwatering melding of flavors."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Oh, Trainer. Your face says you could eat the whole thing right now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the hamburger steak would be happy to see it bring you so much joy.
choice_data_list: Huh? Aren't you going to eat it?
Huh? Aren't you going to eat it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You're the one who won first-prize, so it's yours!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain to Super Creek that I only won because she gave me the raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Really? Then I'll happily join you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now that we've got a kitchen to use, it's time to start cooking! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll even whip up your favorite salad and soup to go with it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's settled! Let's enjoy it together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Super Creek and I enjoy the ultimate tasting experience.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Gosh, look at how many carrots you got!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy for you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, you won them, so they're yours!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite what she says, I only won the prize because she gave me the raffle ticket.
choice_data_list: The raffle ticket was yours to begin with, so you should take them!
The raffle ticket was yours to begin with, so you should take them!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I suppose I shouldn't refuse if you really insist… Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I've made up my mind, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm going to use these carrots to cook for you every day!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll make dishes that both carrot lovers and haters alike will enjoy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, don't worry! I've got plenty of recipes up my sleeve.
choice_data_list: …But I'd like you to eat the carrots too.
…But I'd like you to eat the carrots too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that there are too many carrots for me to finish and that they wouldn't taste as good if I ate them alone anyway.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness, I can't believe I didn't realize that! Then I'll join you for each meal.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm looking forward to it, beginning tomorrow! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I reluctantly agree, and we head home.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Aww, what an adorable carrot! It's got a nice sheen and looks really juicy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look at the prize as Super Creek gushes and notice that it does indeed seem like quality produce.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The label says, "Organic carrot grown in northern soil."
choice_data_list: Here, this prize is yours, Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What? Really?
choice_data_list: Of course. You're the one who gave me the raffle ticket.
Of course. You're the one who gave me the raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then I'll gladly accept it. Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I know! Since this is such a nice carrot, let's try planting it in the vegetable patch! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We can share them with everyone at the academy if we harvest a ton of them!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, let's get planting tomorrow. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We plant the carrot, and sometime later, it sprouts. I gaze upon the new bud and feel a boost of energy!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Not at all! As long as you enjoyed yourself, I'm happy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her kindness makes me feel even more crushed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to give her something, so I go to the exchange counter to claim the tissues, and hand them over to her.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: For me? Really?
choice_data_list: Of course. You're the one who gave me the raffle ticket.
Of course. You're the one who gave me the raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then I'll gladly accept…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer? Don't let it get to you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Seeing your sad face makes me sad too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek and I bond over our shared sorrow for a while.
